punchline: Spread Networks could not make light faster, so it straightened the road.
thirty_sec: Spread Networks built a roughly 825-mile fibre line from Chicago to New Jersey, drawn as straight as lakes, highways and houses allowed, and advertised 13.33 ms round trip in June 2010 against rivals' 15.9 and 17.1 ms; later microwave links through the air went below it.
question: Which piece of your weekly work travels a longer path than it needs to?
key_contrast: Shorten the route, not just the step.
